v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Fáciem meam * non avérti ab increpántibus, et conspuéntibus in me.
text.en: I hid not my face * from shame and spitting.

text.la: Frámea, suscitáre * advérsus eos, qui dispérgunt gregem meum.
text.en: Awake, O sword, * against them that scatter my flock.

text.la: Appendérunt * mercédem meam trigínta argénteis: quibus appretiátus sum ab eis.
text.en: They took the thirty pieces of silver, * my price, that I was prized at of them.

text.la: Inundavérunt aquæ * super caput meum: dixi, Périi: invocábo nomen tuum, Dómine Deus.
text.en: Waters flowed over mine head; * I said I am cut off; I will call upon thy Name, O Lord God.

text.la: Lábia insurgéntium, * et cogitatiónes eórum vide, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, behold the lips * of those that rose up against me, and their device.

text.la: Veníte, mittámus lignum in panem eius, et eradámus eum de terra vivéntium, et nomen eius non memorétur ámplius.
text.en: Come, let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Clarífica me, Pater, * apud temetípsum claritáte, quam hábui priúsquam mundus fíeret.
text.en: And now, O Father, glorify Thou Me * with thine Own Self, with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

text.la: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui in tot advérsis ex nostra infirmitáte defícimus; intercedénte unigéniti Fílii tui passióne respirémus:
text.en: O Almighty God, Which knowest that we be set in such straits that we have no power of ourselves to help ourselves, we pray thee mercifully to relieve us, for whom continually pleadeth the suffering of thine Only Begotten Son. Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
